_comment: EXCELLENT-HARD SearchBrain profile: tuned to WIN contested matches vs an active attacker by counter-pressuring (attacking while defending) instead of going pure-defense under garbage. Loaded by the deployed hard bot. Eval DEFAULTS stay at robust values (counterPressure=0 == robust-hard); this profile turns the knobs up. Schema = bot/profiles/example.json.

_meta.style: COUNTER-PRESSURE: keeps attacking (combos) while buried so it reaches and wins the contested states a pure-defense bot never enters. counterPressure relaxes the buried offense-suppression (0.35 -> 0.74 offenseScale). comboUnit up for combo volume; chainDepthWhenSafe slightly up to build a little deeper when fully safe.
_meta.tunedAgainst: win-rate vs bot/profiles/kekeke.json (aggressive high-builder), offense-under-pressure, survival p10.
